## Checklist

- [ ] Every claim cites a source declared in the same file
- [ ] Sources are primary (developer docs, model cards, licence files, pricing pages, papers, code); community sources only in hardware fit, benchmarks or limitations
- [ ] New or changed entries are `status = "draft"` (a maintainer verifies)
- [ ] `python scripts/validate.py` passes
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
